title: Sleeping Gods
subtitle: Cooperative nautical exploration and storybook survival across the Wandering Sea
tagline: Explore the Wandering Sea and awaken the slumbering gods
loreSummary: The year is 1929. The steamship Manticore is lost in a strange, uncharted world. You and your crew must explore mysterious islands, survive perilous encounters, and discover the totems of the gods to find your way home.
roadmapTitle: 🧭 Wandering Sea Log & Divine Totem Timeline
keyFeatures: Rich storybook-driven exploration with hundreds of branching quests
Tactical combat synergy system with weapon skills and condition damage
Expansive atlas navigation aboard the steamship Manticore
Persistent campaign unlocks with totems, recipes, and quest cards

sg_standard.name: Standard Campaign (Full Journey)
sg_standard.description: A complete voyage through the Wandering Sea completing major quests and collecting divine totems.

sg_quick.name: Short Exploratory Expedition
sg_quick.description: A streamlined nautical expedition exploring nearby archipelagos and solving introductory quests.

milestones.title: First Tide of the Wandering Sea
milestones.phase: Voyage Phase I - The Uncharted Archipelago
milestones.description: Surviving the first pass through the treacherous event deck and establishing supply ports along the reef.

milestones.title: The Whispering Totems
milestones.description: Recovering the first sacred totems from jungle ruins and deciphering the witch's cryptic star-charts.

milestones.title: The Abyssal Maelstrom
milestones.phase: Voyage Phase III - Storm of the Old Ones
milestones.description: Sailing through the final devastating event cycle while sea monsters hunt the fragile hull of the Manticore.

milestones.title: The Gods Awaken
milestones.phase: Voyage Phase IV - The Journey Home
milestones.description: Reaching the sacred mountain altar to awaken the sleeping deities and open the rift back to New York.
